summary_en: Apostolic Letter 'Egregiae virtutis' of John Paul II, 31 December 1980, by which Sts Cyril and Methodius are constituted and declared heavenly co-patrons of the whole of Europe alongside St Benedict, with all the liturgical honours and privileges that belong to principal patrons of places. No protocol number is printed; the liturgical consequences (feast on 14 February throughout Europe) are set out in the Congregation's circular letter of 18 January 1981 (Prot. CD 199/81).
excerpt: Itaque certa scientia ac matura deliberatione Nostra deque apostolicae potestatis plenitudine harum Litterarum vi perpetuumque in modum Sanctos Cyrillum et Methodium totius Europae apud Deum caelestes Compatronos constituimus ac declaramus, omnibus adiectis honoribus ac privilegiis Liturgicis, quae praecipuis locorum Patronis rite competunt.

celebration.name_latin: Sancti Cyrillus, monachus, et Methodius, episcopus

summary_en: Circular letter of the Congregation for the Sacraments and Divine Worship to the presidents of the episcopal conferences of Europe: following 'Egregiae virtutis', from 1981 the celebration of Sts Cyril and Methodius is to be kept in all parts of Europe with the grade of feast, on the day already fixed in the Roman Calendar (14 February), with Gloria at Mass and the Office as on solemnities except the little hours; where by particular law the saints are already celebrated on a different day or grade, that day and grade are kept.
excerpt: 1. Celebratio Ss. Cyrilli, monachi, et Methodii, episcopi, a vertente anno 1981, peragenda erit gradu Festi. Namque Sancti Cyrillus et Methodius, uti Sanctus Benedictus, posthac Europae Patroni coluntur. [...] 2. Novus celebrationis gradus nullam secumfert variationem circa diem, quo ipsa celebratio peragitur, prout in Calendario Romano invenitur, nempe 14 februarii.

summary_en: Particular calendar of the diocese of Langres (Lingonensis): decree of 7 October 1981, the same decree that confirmed the French text of the diocesan Proper of Masses (Summarium p. 585). The Summarium prints only the name, date and protocol under the heading 'Calendaria particularia' (no verb, no detail); recorded as an approval of the particular calendar per the coordinator's ruling.
excerpt: Lingonensis, 7 octobris 1981 (Prot. CD 1232/81).

summary_en: Archdiocese of Lucca: the celebration of the Finding of the Holy Cross may be kept on 3 May with the grade of feast.
excerpt: Lucensis, 19 octobris 1981 (Prot. CD 1277/81): conceditur ut celebratio « in inventione Sanctae Crucis » quotannis die 3 maii gradu festi peragi possit.

summary_en: The celebration of St Marie-Bernarde (Bernadette) Soubirous may be inserted in the calendar of the dioceses of Nigeria on 16 April as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Nigeriae dioeceses, 2 octobris 1981 (Prot. CD 1033/81): conceditur ut celebratio Sanctae Mariae Bernardae Subirous in Calendarium dioecesium Nigeriae inseri valeat, quotannis die 16 aprilis gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

summary_en: The celebration of Blessed Alain de Solminihac, bishop, may be inserted in the calendar of the diocese of Périgueux (Petrocoricensis) on 3 January as an obligatory memorial; the same decree confirmed the French texts of the collect and second reading for his Mass and Office (Summarium p. 585).
excerpt: Petrocoricensis, 5 octobris 1981 (Prot. CD 1221/81): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Alani de Solminihac, episcopi, in Calendarium dioecesis inseri valeat, quotannis die 3 ianuarii gradu memoriae obligatoriae peragenda.

summary_en: Diocese of Rome: the liturgical celebration of St Frances of Rome may be kept on 9 March with the grade of feast in the Basilica of St Cecilia. Marked for review because the concession is limited to one church, not the whole diocesan calendar.
excerpt: Romana, 19 octobris 1981 (Prot. CD 1279/81): conceditur ut celebratio liturgica Sanctae Franciscae Romanae, in Basilica Sanctae Caeciliae, quotannis die 9 martii gradu festi peragi valeat.

summary_en: The celebration of Blessed Luigi Scrosoppi may be inserted in the calendar of the archdiocese of Udine (Utinensis) on 5 October as an obligatory memorial.
excerpt: Utinensis, 7 octobris 1981 (Prot. CD 1243/81): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Aloisii Scrosoppi in Calendarium archidioecesis inseri valeat, quotannis die 5 octobris gradu memoriae obligatoriae peragenda.

summary_en: The celebration of Blessed Luigi Scrosoppi may be inserted in the calendar of the Congregation of the Sisters of Providence on 5 October as a feast.
excerpt: Congregatio sororum a Providentia, 7 octobris 1981 (Prot. CD 1245/81): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Aloisii Scrosoppi in Calendarium Congregationis inseri valeat, quotannis die 5 octobris gradu festi peragenda.

summary_en: The celebration of the Blessed Virgin Mary Mediatrix may be inserted in the calendar of the Congregation of the Missionary Sisters of Christ the King on 31 August as a feast; the same decree confirmed the texts of her Mass and Office (Summarium p. 586).
excerpt: Congregatio sororum missionariarum Christi Regis, 8 octobris 1981 (Prot. CD 1237/81): conceditur ut celebratio Beatae Mariae Virginis Mediatricis in Calendarium Congregationis inseri valeat, quotannis die 31 augusti gradu festi peragenda.

summary_en: Archdiocese of Capua: confirmation of the election of St Vincent de Paul, priest, as secondary Patron before God of the town of Casagiove.
